steps.title: Common misconception
steps.say: Seasons are not caused by Earth being closer to the Sun. The real cause is the tilt of Earth's axis.

ops.text: It's NOT because Earth is closer to the Sun.
The real cause is the tilt of Earth's axis.

steps.title: Sun and orbit
steps.say: Earth travels around the Sun in a nearly circular orbit once a year.

steps.title: Tilted axis
steps.say: Earth's axis is tilted about 23.4 degrees, and it keeps pointing the same direction as Earth orbits.

ops.text:
Axis tilted 23.4°
always points the same way

steps.title: Six months later
steps.say: Six months later, Earth is on the opposite side of its orbit, and the tilt still points the same way.

ops.text: Six months later: the other side

steps.title: Summary
steps.say: When your hemisphere tilts toward the Sun, sunlight is more direct and days are longer, so it is summer. When it tilts away, it is winter.

ops.text: Tilt toward Sun = summer · Tilt away = winter
